info.title: LocalBase
info.summary: A self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible gateway for local AI models.
info.description: `/v1` is the stable API. `/_localbase` is for administering one installation, and can change between releases. Errors use the OpenAI envelope; branch on `error.code`. A request carrying `Origin` or `Sec-Fetch-Site` never authenticates with an API key, and the gateway sends no CORS headers, so a key cannot be used from a web page.

post.summary: Resolve an import source, start the import, or cancel it
post.description: Cancelling differs from cancelling an install, on purpose. An import is identified by its `job`, and cancelling removes what it downloaded, because its source may change between tries. An install is identified by `modelId` and keeps its partial file, because a pinned checksum makes resuming safe.

post.summary: Install, uninstall, enable, disable or activate a model, or cancel its install
post.description: One install runs at a time, in the background. `GET` reports its progress. `models:manage`, or the instance token, cancel only: this machine's CLI can use the token from the root's lock file, on a request from loopback, for `action: cancel` and nothing else.

200.description: Done. A cancelled install answers here with state `cancelled`. A cancel with no install of this model running answers here too, with the operation recorded for it, unchanged, so a retry is safe.

language.description: With none, audio is treated as English, even on a multilingual model. Send `auto` to detect, or a code such as `es`.

UpdateState.description: What is stored. Reading asks nobody.

latest.description: The newest release this gateway has seen, when the check is on.

updateAvailable.description: Only with the check on, and only on a release build.

UsageReport.description: Hourly totals. Counts, tokens and durations only: never prompts, replies, bodies, file names or key material.

from.description: Where the answer really starts, after retention.

errorRate.description: (failed + refused) / requests. A client going away (499) is not an error.

requestsWithTokens.description: How many requests reported tokens, so a total is not misread as complete.

approximate.description: Within about 12%: totals are hourly, with no per-request rows.

id.description: A key's id, or a browser identity's opaque owner hash. Never an email or a name.

name.description: A key's label, read when usage is read. Only for a key that still exists.

model.description: A model id the gateway knows, or empty.

groups.description: By request count, most first. It is a count, not a ranking of anything's quality.

series.description: A step with no requests is left out.
